Part of #26640 — its remaining half, split off at review of #26683.

Nothing runs that rewrite yet, so copies written before the release keep the columns until an operator can run it.
Reader: the seat owning `packages/cli` (the `os migrate` family).

- The command is registered in the one-shot family pin (`schema-migrate.one-shot-family.integration.test.ts`) and has a dogfood case, as the precedent does.
- The upgrade guide names the command beside the release that ships it.
- ⛔ Disclosure discipline: #26640 is withheld pending maintainer. Command help, docs, changeset and PR text describe the rewrite neutrally ("removes encrypted key-material columns from ledger copies"); no reproduction, door or capability name.
